notes:
E-Sys MAX 5.1.2

Fixed
- Updates from inside E-Sys MAX could stop with "The update did not install". Updating works again, also from the Demo to the full version after buying.

Improved
- Fault lists open without the window freezing.
- Error and warning messages stay on screen until you have read them; only good news slides away by itself.
- Clearer messages when an update download stalls or E-Sys is already open.
- German: many more screens, messages and service texts are now in German.
- Screen readers: buttons, switches, lists and result lines now have names and are read out when they change.
- An activation code can also be entered in About > Enter licence.
- Many smaller fixes.

If you are on 5.0.0 to 5.1.1: install 5.1.2 once from your personal download link. After that, updates install by themselves again.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
